name: contact-form-site
description: A one-page small business website with a spam-protected contact form, free on Cloudflare.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Your Turnstile **site key** (Cloudflare dashboard → Turnstile → Add widget). The default is Cloudflare's always-pass test key.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Your Turnstile **secret key**, from the same widget. The default always passes, so replace it before you go live.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The password for the `/messages` page, where you read what people send. Use a long one.

DB.description: A free D1 database that keeps the messages.
